title: Compare Two Places to Live
instructions: Read the example aloud for practice, then record your own response with different details.
prompt: Compare two fictional places to live. Describe their rooms, rent and bills, say what you would check in the agreement, and explain your choice. Speak for 90–120 seconds and use at least six different lesson words.
reference: I am comparing two apartments near my class. The first apartment has a larger bedroom, while the second has a more spacious kitchen. The monthly rent is lower at the first place, but I still need to ask about the electricity bill. I would also check whether the bathroom is private and whether the heating is included. Before I move, I want to read the lease and ask the landlord about any damage. I will take photographs of the wall and floor so I can discuss any marks clearly. The first place looks quiet enough for study, but I will compare the travel time and the full agreement before I decide.
